provenance.description: Original EviTriage-QL Gate C-Extra fixture; no third-party source was copied.

source.source_fact: Socket.getInputStream supplies remote data that BufferedReader.readLine consumes as a filename.
source.sink_fact: The unvalidated filename reaches Path.resolve and Files.readString without a containment check.

ground_truth.label: TP
ground_truth.rationale: A remote peer can supply an absolute or parent-traversing path and the fixture performs no normalization, allowlist, or document-root containment check before reading it.
